definitions.explanation: A person who has legally adopted a child and taken on the role of parent. Used in both legal and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}のもとで{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I was raised by adoptive parents.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}と{養子|ようし}の{関係|かんけい}は{法律|ほうりつ}で{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: The relationship between adoptive parents and adopted children is recognized by law.

examples.japanese: {養親|ようしん}になるためには、{家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}の{許可|きょか}が{必要|ひつよう}な{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: In some cases, permission from the family court is required to become an adoptive parent.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and formal term. The opposite is {実親|じっしん} (biological parent). In Japanese law, there are two types of adoption: {普通養子縁組|ふつうようしえんぐみ} (ordinary adoption) and {特別養子縁組|とくべつようしえんぐみ} (special adoption), each with different legal implications for the {養親|ようしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養親|ようしん}になる (to become an adoptive parent)
- {養親|ようしん}と{養子|ようし} (adoptive parent and adopted child)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実親|じっしん}: biological parent — the parent by birth
- {里親|さとおや}: foster parent — may not have legal adoption status
